title: Pitch and Loudness
summary: Frequency sets the pitch; amplitude sets the loudness. Audible sound, infrasound and ultrasound, and what different animals can hear.

ib.note: Wave equation v = fλ follows in MYP 4–5

cbse.chapter: Exploration (2026) Ch 10: Sound Waves: Characteristics and Applications (frequency, amplitude, pitch, loudness, range of hearing)

objectives: I can relate pitch to frequency and loudness to amplitude.
I can state the human range of hearing (about 20 Hz to 20,000 Hz).
I can describe infrasound and ultrasound, with uses.
misconceptions: Pitch and loudness are the same thing.
A high-pitched sound is always loud.
